title: Selank vs Semax
summary: Selank: tier human clinical trial, 96 indexed publications, 2 randomized trials. Semax: tier human clinical trial, 208 indexed publications, 1 randomized trials. 2 indexed studies compare them directly; the head-to-head section quotes what they state.

seo.title: Selank vs Semax: what the studies show
seo.description: Selank vs Semax, side by side from each compound's own cited record, plus any direct head-to-head trial. Not advice.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2017: Analysis of differentiation of embryonic stem cells into GABA + neurons showed that Selank, thyroliberin (100 μM), and NGF (100 ng/ml) decrease the ratio of these cells by 61, 58, and 87%, respectively, in comparison with the control.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, rats, 2014: Biologically active regulatory peptide, tripeptide Pro-Gly-Pro (PGP) was used as C-terminal fragment for peptide drugs Semax and Selank.
